h: Consolation Restores Every Place Wounded by Sin

p: Further in the Pesikta (the new one),
כִּי זֶה מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ (שְׁמוֹת לב, א)
and said, It is not He';
'I, I am He Who comforts you.'"
Now its listing of the limbs
it lists that they sinned with all of them,
were struck with all of them,
and are consoled with all of them,
since the willful sins became like merits,
with which they sinned and were struck,
and they were consoled with them.
that they sinned with them, were struck with them,
that the meaning of the word "zeh"
is that it is plain to the eye,
to the point of pointing with a finger:
and that is why they merited to say
And likewise when it is plain
the word "zeh" can also be used;
from what they said, of blessed memory
"Yet all this — zeh — is worth nothing to me"
and this is what is written
that it was plain to them in the heart
that they saw the image of Moshe who had died
also as though plain to the eye;
even though it was not before their eyes,
since they were exiled to Bavel,
the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash
was engraved on their hearts constantly,
as though pointing with a finger;
as though seeing with their eyes
every one of Yisrael will merit
"Behold, this is our God; we hoped for Him;
this is Hashem; we hoped for Him."
And as it says (end of Taanis; 31a):
"In the future the Holy One, blessed is He,
will make a circle-dance for the tzaddikim," etc.
and this is according to what is written
And this is what it says:
as it is written: They denied Hashem
and said, It is not He"
and the sin reached the root.
which reaches up to the Throne of Glory"
that reached up to the Throne of Glory.
Great is the power of teshuvah,
for as soon as a person
up to the Throne of Glory;
עַד ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ (הוֹשֵׁעַ יד, ב) וְכוּלֵּי
'For our iniquities have risen higher than our heads,
וְאַשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ גָּדְלוּ עַד לַשָּׁמָיִם (עֶזְרָא ט, ו)
and our guilt has grown up to the heavens' (Ezra 9:6);
the Holy One, blessed is He, said:
if they reach the firmament, etc.,
up to the Throne of Glory,
וְהַיְינוּ כְּפֵירוּשׁ הָרֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
And this is like the explanation of the Reishis Chochmah above:
that "up to the Throne of Glory"
that is, the sin reached the root,
up to the aspect of Atika;
and the Ancient of Days sat";
"Your throne is established from then — me'az"
for this is the aspect of the revelation of Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב נד, א)
And the expression "up to the Throne of Glory" denotes
the aspect of the attribute of Atika.
as it says, And He fought against them":
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (מְגִילָּה ג, א)
in the manner of what is written (Megillah 3a):
אַף עַל גַּב דְּאִינְהוּ לָא חָזוּ
for such is the matter of the holy mazala,
and it says in Asarah Maamaros
is the mazal of the son,"
for it is the root, the father.
I, I am He Who comforts you"
which denotes up to the aspect of Atika.

p: depicted in the image of a complete stature;
And although it did not list them in the order
in which they are listed in Pesach Eliyahu,
it corresponds to the attribute of Atika;
for when there is a revelation of the attribute of Atika,
as at the splitting of the Sea,
they merited to say "This is my God,"
that it be plain in the heart
what he gauges in his heart.
and they are consoled with fire (Zechariah 2:9):
'And I will be for her,' etc.,
in all three roots of the kelipos:
for the culmination of honor and pride
is to the point of saying,
"I will be like the Most High" (Yeshayahu 14:14),
like a pillar of fire," etc.;
And so it is explicit in the pasuk
like an oven heated by the baker."
And of the kelipah of idolatry
as "and his wrath burned within him"
"Nine hundred and three kinds of death,"
And this is what it says,
for the destruction of the First Temple
was because of these three transgressions
the holiness of the three Avos,
and this is what it says:
"And I will be for her," etc.,
against the aspect of the Holy One, blessed is He,
which is the Torah He commanded;
against the aspect of the Shechinah
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (יְשַׁעְיָה נ, א)
in the manner of what it says (Yeshayahu 50:1):
"and for your transgressions your mother was sent away."
for willful sins become like merits for him;
And similar to what they said, of blessed memory
that willful sins become like merits for him.
And to this the word "already" points:
that is, from the root of Atika:
from the six days of Creation
that they will be like merits.
and this is "they are consoled doubly."
